reserveReview.rationale: Renewed on 2026-11-22 from the live Accountable dashboard API (dashboard ts 2026-11-22T15:31:11.623Z; exposure_split_ts 2026.11.17 07:50:11 UTC). The Alpha exposure_split reports 21 buckets (20 positive totaling $49,714,082.39 and one signed negative [Ethena]_USDe_Loop entry of -$10,088,325.50, netting to $39,625,756.89). Cross-checking reserves_breakdown_defi.Reserves.Ethena ($21,115,792.79) matches the exact net of [Ethena]_sUSDe_Loop (+$31,204,118.30) plus [Ethena]_USDe_Loop (-$10,088,325.50 = $21,115,792.80), so net Ethena loop equity is assigned to Ethena sUSDe loop (51.238320%) while retaining the Ethena USDe loop sourceKey row at 0% for live-adapter classification. Denominated against the nearest contemporaneous timeline reserve total ($41,210,938.74 at 2026-11-16T23:46:10.812Z, 8.07 hours before exposure_split_ts; the +15.93h bracket at 2026-11-17T23:46:09.935Z is $40,955,301.48), an unattributed reconciliation shortfall of $1,585,181.85 (3.846507%) persists (3.246331% against the later bracket). Rather than normalizing attributed buckets to 100%, that exact 3.846507% gap is preserved explicitly as an Unattributed backing unclassifiedResidual slice alongside Rest_of_Assets ($205,698.44, 0.499136%) and unverified [Re]_PT_reUSD ($179,025.31, 0.434412%), totaling 4.780055% knownUnknownExposurePct. Prime RWA exposure_split_rwa ($7.71M) remains excluded from Alpha (yzUSD). All previously reviewed sourceKey classification rows that currently sit at zero are retained at 0% so live adapter matching stays intact. Confidence remains probable because both the 3.846507% unattributed shortfall (exceeding the 2% maxUnattributedResidualShare ceiling so the live accountable adapter fails closed) and the -$10.09M signed negative Ethena leg persist without gross asset-versus-debt or contract-level disclosure. On 2026-11-27, row 8 (Fasanara mGLO loop, 1.407969%) was linked directly to newly admitted mglo-midas-fasanara while keeping composition weights and knownUnknownExposurePct (4.780055%) unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable Alpha exposure_split snapshot dated 2026-11-17 07:50:11 UTC (with Ethena sUSDe/USDe loop legs netted to match reserves_breakdown_defi.Reserves.Ethena), divided by the nearest contemporaneous timeline reserve total ($41,210,938.74 at 2026-11-16T23:46:10.812Z) with the exact 3.846507% ($1,585,181.85) unattributed reconciliation shortfall preserved as an explicit slice
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: As of the 2026-11-17 07:50:11 UTC Accountable exposure_split (observed 2026-11-22T15:42Z), three unattributed or unverified components total 4.780055% of the $41,210,938.74 nearest contemporaneous timeline reserve total: (1) 3.846507% ($1,585,181.85) unattributed reconciliation shortfall between the net exposure_split sum ($39,625,756.89) and the nearest timeline total ($41,210,938.74; shortfall is 3.246331% against the 2026-11-17T23:46Z bracket $40,955,301.48), which exceeds Yuzu's 2% maxUnattributedResidualShare band and causes the live accountable adapter to fail closed; (2) 0.499136% ($205,698.44) in Accountable's unmapped Rest_of_Assets bucket; and (3) 0.434412% ($179,025.31) in [Re]_PT_reUSD, whose exact held PT contract, market, expiry, and ultimate obligor remain unverified. In addition, [Ethena]_USDe_Loop is reported as a -$10,088,325.50 signed negative entry offsetting +$31,204,118.30 [Ethena]_sUSDe_Loop; while their net ($21,115,792.80) matches reserves_breakdown_defi.Reserves.Ethena ($21,115,792.79), the feed discloses neither gross collateral and strategy-debt legs across chains nor exact held LP/PT contracts. Prime RWA exposure_split_rwa ($7,713,486.43) is excluded from Alpha. Next evidence: reconciled Alpha-only gross position and debt inventory eliminating the 3.85% under-coverage gap and signed negative bucket.
